name: unique-alias
description: Codex, Pi, and Pi native credentials bind through one covered-key row before default.

name: base-regression
description: The base revision leaves an alias unranked or reads an exhausted default; the target selects the 80% row.

name: exact-first
description: An exhausted exact account wins over two healthy aliases and a healthy default in either row order.

name: ambiguous
description: Conflicting aliases remain eligible and unranked even with a healthy default; the helper selects none.

name: provider-scope
description: The same alias on another provider does not conflict, independently of row order.

name: whitespace-alias
description: Whitespace aliases remain valid for the resolver, worker helper, and quota event consumer.

name: compatibility
description: Exact rows, default fallback, missing rows, and schema 5 retain their behavior, including absent accountKeys.

name: malformed
description: The real helper rejects all 12 malformed alias shapes and still rejects whitespace in accountKey.

name: valid-edge-inputs
description: Empty arrays, repeated aliases in one row, whitespace strings, and schema-5 field handling remain valid.
